caveat: Integrated assessment models are climate-policy instruments, not digital twins; test how far the legitimacy argument transfers.
source: Journal watch: Sustainability Science (via web search; Crossref blocked)
title: Advancing key transdisciplinary principles: enabling co-production in integrated assessment modelling for sustainable development
why: Vienni-Baptista applies co-production principles inside modelling practice, arguing the legitimacy problem lives in how a model is built rather than in its outputs. The closest thing yet to a TD critique you can use on Digital Twin Flevoland.
